description: Disjoint finite families of subsets have a finite coordinate set separating every positive trace from every negative trace, and separation persists upon enlarging that coordinate set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.finite_trace_separation (E H : Finset (Set ℕ)) (hd : Disjoint E H) :
  ∃ F₀, ∀ (F : Finset ℕ), F₀ ⊆ F → ∀ A ∈ E, ∀ B ∈ H, {x ∈ F | x ∈ A} ≠ {x ∈ F | x ∈ B}
